# Drupal deprecations

The Drupal API deprecations `scripts/analysis/explain-deprecations.sh` explains, from `config/deprecations.json`. Each pattern is a POSIX extended regular expression matched against the analyzers' messages. (drupilot's own deprecated settings are a different page.)

## `CKEditor 5`

- **Pattern:** `ckeditor4|ckeditor/ckeditor|core/ckeditor\b`
- **Category:** ckeditor
- **What changed:** CKEditor 4 removed; CKEditor 5 is the only core editor.
- **Fix:** Migrate the editor config/plugins to CKEditor 5 (often non-mechanical — consider Phase 2).
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=CKEditor%205>

## `ConfigFormBase TypedConfigManagerInterface`

- **Pattern:** `\[signature:config-form-base-ctor\]`
- **Category:** signature-change
- **What changed:** ConfigFormBase::__construct() takes a second argument, TypedConfigManagerInterface $typedConfigManager: optional (omitting it deprecated) in 10.2-10.x, REQUIRED from 11.0. A subclass constructor that calls parent::__construct($config_factory) alone throws ArgumentCountError on Drupal 11.
- **Fix:** Add TypedConfigManagerInterface $typed_config_manager to the subclass constructor, forward it (parent::__construct($config_factory, $typed_config_manager)) and pass $container-&gt;get('config.typed') from create().
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=ConfigFormBase%20TypedConfigManagerInterface>

## `ContainerFactoryPluginInterface`

- **Pattern:** `\[plugin-di\]|\[removed-use\]`
- **Category:** port-safety
- **What changed:** A class with create() must implement ContainerFactoryPluginInterface (plugins) or ContainerInjectionInterface (forms/controllers); QueueWorkerBase, BlockBase, FilterBase, ActionBase and core PluginBase do not provide it.
- **Fix:** Keep/restore 'implements ContainerFactoryPluginInterface' and its use statement (check-port-safety.sh).
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=ContainerFactoryPluginInterface>

## `ContentTranslationController TimeInterface`

- **Pattern:** `\[signature:content-translation-controller-ctor\]`
- **Category:** signature-change
- **What changed:** ContentTranslationController::__construct() takes a third argument, TimeInterface $time: optional (omitting it deprecated) in 10.3-10.x, REQUIRED from 11.0. A subclass passing only the manager and the entity field manager throws ArgumentCountError on Drupal 11.
- **Fix:** Accept TimeInterface $time in the subclass constructor, forward it as the third parent argument and pass $container-&gt;get('datetime.time') from create().
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=ContentTranslationController%20TimeInterface>

## `DependencySerializationTrait`

- **Pattern:** `\[serialization\]`
- **Category:** serialization
- **What changed:** DependencySerializationTrait runs from the base-class scope: __sleep() drops private child properties and __wakeup() cannot re-initialize readonly ones.
- **Fix:** Declare injected services protected and non-readonly in forms and plugins.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=DependencySerializationTrait>

## `Drupal::url`

- **Pattern:** `\\Drupal::url\b`
- **Category:** routing-url
- **What changed:** \Drupal::url() removed.
- **Fix:** Use Url::fromRoute()/fromUri() and the 'url_generator' service.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=Drupal%3A%3Aurl>

## `EntityInterface::getOriginal`

- **Pattern:** `\[signature:entity-get-original\]`
- **Category:** signature-change
- **What changed:** Drupal 11.2 added EntityInterface::getOriginal(): ?static (implemented by EntityBase). An entity class that already declares its own getOriginal() without a compatible return type is a fatal 'Declaration must be compatible' on 11.2+; a compatible one silently replaces core's method there.
- **Fix:** While the core floor is below 11.2: rename the local helper (e.g. getOriginalWidget()) and update its callers. Once the floor is ^11.2: delete it and use core's getOriginal().
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=EntityInterface%3A%3AgetOriginal>

## `EntityInterface::setOriginal`

- **Pattern:** `\[signature:entity-set-original\]`
- **Category:** signature-change
- **What changed:** Drupal 11.2 added EntityInterface::setOriginal(?EntityInterface $original): static. An entity class declaring its own setOriginal() with another signature is a fatal 'Declaration must be compatible' on 11.2+.
- **Fix:** While the core floor is below 11.2: rename the local method. Once the floor is ^11.2: delete it and use core's setOriginal().
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=EntityInterface%3A%3AsetOriginal>

## `EntityManager`

- **Pattern:** `EntityManager(Interface)?\b`
- **Category:** entity-api
- **What changed:** EntityManager split up.
- **Fix:** Use EntityTypeManagerInterface (and the dedicated repository/field managers).
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=EntityManager>

## `Form API callbacks`

- **Pattern:** `\[fapi-callable\]`
- **Category:** forms
- **What changed:** A first-class callable is a closure; closures cannot be serialized, so a cached form (#ajax, form state cache) fatals.
- **Fix:** Use [$this, 'method'], [static::class, 'method'], '::method' or a function-name string under #submit/#validate/#ajax/#process/...
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=Form%20API%20callbacks>

## `Override attribute`

- **Pattern:** `\[override-attribute\]|#\[\\Override\]`
- **Category:** port-safety
- **What changed:** #[\Override] on a method whose parent exists only in newer cores is a compile-time fatal on PHP 8.3+ with the older cores you still declare.
- **Fix:** Do not add #[\Override] while core_version_requirement spans Drupal 10 or an older 11.x minor; add it only when every declared core has the parent method.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=Override%20attribute>

## `PHPUnit 10`

- **Pattern:** `getMock\b|createMock.*willReturn.*at\(`
- **Category:** phpunit
- **What changed:** Legacy PHPUnit mock APIs removed in PHPUnit 10/11.
- **Fix:** Use createMock()/createStub() and the modern matcher API; remove at().
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=PHPUnit%2010>

## `REQUEST_TIME`

- **Pattern:** `REQUEST_TIME`
- **Category:** time
- **What changed:** REQUEST_TIME constant removed.
- **Fix:** Inject the 'datetime.time' service: -&gt;getRequestTime().
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=REQUEST_TIME>

## `assertion`

- **Pattern:** `assert\(.*instanceof|Drupal\\Component\\Assertion`
- **Category:** assertion
- **What changed:** Some assertion helpers changed.
- **Fix:** Use native assert() with class type-hints, or proper type declarations.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=assertion>

## `buildRevisionCacheId`

- **Pattern:** `\[signature:revision-cache-id\]`
- **Category:** signature-change
- **What changed:** Drupal 11.3 added ContentEntityStorageBase::buildRevisionCacheId($id): string, which core calls for its revision memory/persistent cache. A storage subclass declaring a method with that name becomes an override of core on 11.3+ (core then uses its cache ids); with an incompatible signature (no ': string', private, other parameters) it is a fatal at class load on 11.3+.
- **Fix:** Rename the module's helper (e.g. buildWidgetRevisionCacheId()) unless overriding core's revision cache id on 11.3+ is intended; if kept, match protected function buildRevisionCacheId($id): string exactly.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=buildRevisionCacheId>

## `check_markup`

- **Pattern:** `check_markup`
- **Category:** soft-deprecation
- **What changed:** check_markup() is deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0 (soft: it still works on every Drupal 11 and 12 core). There is no direct replacement.
- **Fix:** Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed: return a render array ['#type' =&gt; 'processed_text', '#text' =&gt; $text, '#format' =&gt; $format_id] instead of flattened markup (works on Drupal 10 and 11, and keeps the cacheability metadata); the call site changes from a string to a render array.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=check_markup>

## `db_query`

- **Pattern:** `db_query|db_select|db_insert|db_update|db_delete`
- **Category:** database-api
- **What changed:** Procedural database API removed.
- **Fix:** Inject the 'database' connection service and use its query builders.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=db_query>

## `dependency injection`

- **Pattern:** `\\Drupal::service\(|\\Drupal::(entityTypeManager|currentUser|database|config|state|moduleHandler)\(`
- **Category:** dependency-injection
- **What changed:** Static \Drupal:: service access is discouraged (and brittle to test).
- **Fix:** Constructor-inject the service via create()/ContainerFactoryPluginInterface (Phase 2).
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=dependency%20injection>

## `dependency injection forms`

- **Pattern:** `FormBase::create|ContainerInjectionInterface`
- **Category:** forms
- **What changed:** Forms/controllers should inject services, not call \Drupal:: statically.
- **Fix:** Implement create() and inject the services you need.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=dependency%20injection%20forms>

## `drupal_set_message`

- **Pattern:** `drupal_set_message`
- **Category:** messenger
- **What changed:** Global message helper removed.
- **Fix:** Inject and use the 'messenger' service ($this-&gt;messenger()-&gt;addStatus(...)).
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=drupal_set_message>

## `entity_load`

- **Pattern:** `(entity_load|node_load|user_load|taxonomy_term_load)\b`
- **Category:** entity-api
- **What changed:** Procedural entity loaders removed.
- **Fix:** Use the 'entity_type.manager' service: -&gt;getStorage('node')-&gt;load($id).
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=entity_load>

## `format_date`

- **Pattern:** `format_date|\\Drupal::service\(.date.\)`
- **Category:** date
- **What changed:** format_date() removed.
- **Fix:** Inject the 'date.formatter' service and call -&gt;format().
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=format_date>

## `getOriginal setOriginal`

- **Pattern:** `\[signature:entity-original-accessors-call\]`
- **Category:** signature-change
- **What changed:** -&gt;getOriginal()/-&gt;setOriginal() on a core entity exist only from Drupal 11.2; while the declared range includes an older core the call is an 'undefined method' fatal there (unless the receiver is the module's own class).
- **Fix:** While the floor is below 11.2: keep the -&gt;original property, or wrap the call in DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall() (core 10.1+): backwardsCompatibleCall(\Drupal::VERSION, '11.2', fn() =&gt; $entity-&gt;getOriginal(), fn() =&gt; $entity-&gt;original). Raise the floor to ^11.2 to use it directly.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=getOriginal%20setOriginal>

## `hook_entity_operation CacheableMetadata`

- **Pattern:** `\[signature:hook-entity-operation\]`
- **Category:** signature-change
- **What changed:** From 11.3 core invokes hook_entity_operation() with a second argument, CacheableMetadata $cacheability (EntityListBuilder::getOperations()); earlier cores pass only the entity. An implementation that REQUIRES the second parameter throws ArgumentCountError on every core below 11.3.
- **Fix:** Keep the one-parameter signature, or add the new parameter as optional: ?CacheableMetadata $cacheability = NULL.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=hook_entity_operation%20CacheableMetadata>

## `hook_entity_operation_alter CacheableMetadata`

- **Pattern:** `\[signature:hook-entity-operation-alter\]`
- **Category:** signature-change
- **What changed:** From 11.3 core alters entity operations with a third argument, CacheableMetadata $cacheability; earlier cores pass only (&$operations, $entity). An implementation that REQUIRES the third parameter throws ArgumentCountError below 11.3.
- **Fix:** Keep the two-parameter signature, or add the new parameter as optional: ?CacheableMetadata $cacheability = NULL.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=hook_entity_operation_alter%20CacheableMetadata>

## `jQuery UI`

- **Pattern:** `jquery\.?ui|jquery_ui|core/jquery\.ui`
- **Category:** jquery-ui
- **What changed:** jQuery UI libraries removed from core.
- **Fix:** Replace with a native/JS alternative or the contrib jquery_ui_* shims; re-evaluate the UI in Phase 2.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=jQuery%20UI>

## `new static`

- **Pattern:** `\[static-factory\]`
- **Category:** port-safety
- **What changed:** new self() in create() of a non-final class hands subclasses a parent instance.
- **Fix:** Keep 'new static(' (or make the class final in Phase 2); never change it to silence the sandbox PHPStan.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=new%20static>

## `text_summary`

- **Pattern:** `text_summary`
- **Category:** soft-deprecation
- **What changed:** text_summary() is deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0 (soft: it still works on every Drupal 11 and 12 core). Its replacement, the TextSummary service, exists only from Drupal 11.4.
- **Fix:** Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed while the core floor is below 11.4: DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall(\Drupal::VERSION, '11.4.0', fn() =&gt; \Drupal::service(TextSummary::class)-&gt;generate($text, $format, $size), fn() =&gt; text_summary($text, $format, $size)) - a bare TextSummary call fatals on older cores. generate() needs an int size: pass the text.settings default_summary_length when the original passed NULL.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=text_summary>

## `twig spaceless`

- **Pattern:** `spaceless`
- **Category:** twig
- **What changed:** Twig {% spaceless %} removed in Twig 3.
- **Fix:** Use Twig's whitespace control: the '-' modifier ({%- ... -%}, {{- ... -}}) trims the whitespace next to a tag. Never move to the 'spaceless' filter: it is deprecated since Twig 3.12.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=twig%20spaceless>

## `update hooks`

- **Pattern:** `hook_(install|update|uninstall)|hook_update_N`
- **Category:** update-hooks
- **What changed:** Update path semantics matter for a port.
- **Fix:** Keep existing hook_update_N intact; do not renumber. Add new ones only for real schema/config changes.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=update%20hooks>

## `user_cookie_save`

- **Pattern:** `user_cookie_(save|delete)`
- **Category:** soft-deprecation
- **What changed:** user_cookie_save()/user_cookie_delete() are deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0 with no replacement (soft: they still work on every Drupal 11 and 12 core).
- **Fix:** Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed: inline core's own body, e.g. setrawcookie('Drupal.visitor.' . $field, rawurlencode($value), \Drupal::time()-&gt;getRequestTime() + 31536000, '/') - works on every core.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=user_cookie_save>

## `user_load_by_name`

- **Pattern:** `user_load_by_(name|mail)`
- **Category:** soft-deprecation
- **What changed:** user_load_by_name()/user_load_by_mail() are deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0: they still work on every Drupal 11 and 12 core (a SOFT deprecation).
- **Fix:** Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed: $users = \Drupal::entityTypeManager()-&gt;getStorage('user')-&gt;loadByProperties(['name' =&gt; $name]) (or ['mail' =&gt; $mail]); $account = $users ? reset($users) : FALSE; - works on Drupal 10 and 11.
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=user_load_by_name>

## `user_roles`

- **Pattern:** `user_roles\(|Function user_roles |user_role_names`
- **Category:** removed-api
- **What changed:** user_roles() and user_role_names() were deprecated in drupal:10.2.0 and REMOVED in drupal:11.0.0: a call is an undefined-function fatal on every Drupal 11 core (a HARD deprecation, always fixed in Phase 1).
- **Fix:** Use \Drupal\user\Entity\Role::loadMultiple() (available on Drupal 10) and filter inline: user_roles(TRUE) excluded the anonymous role (RoleInterface::ANONYMOUS_ID); user_role_names() mapped the roles to $role-&gt;label().
- **Change records:** <https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/drupal?keywords_description=user_roles>
